name: When should I call a professional for mildew smell removal?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for mildew smell removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional for mildew smell removal if the odor persists despite your cleaning efforts, if you see widespread mold growth (larger than a small patch), or if you suspect mold is hidden behind walls or under flooring. Professionals are also necessary after significant water damage, like a flood or burst pipe, to ensure complete drying and prevent future mold. They have specialized equipment to detect hidden moisture, contain contamination, safely remove mold, and use industrial-grade air scrubbers to eliminate odors, ensuring a healthier environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for mildew smell removal if the odor persists, mold growth is extensive or hidden, or after significant water damage. They have tools for detection, safe removal, and air purification.
